title: Ordinary class transport through normalized scalar endpoints
statement: For normalized endpoints e over T and a derived Chern arrow c over A, the ordinary finite class of e.chernImage c over B equals the cohomology image under the underlying additive map of e.lineInsertion of the ordinary finite class of c over A.

proof.text: Transpose the conjugate defining e.chernImage through the scalar adjunction, use e.unit_derived and e.line_derived and the canonical shift comparison, then apply exact-functor Ext composition comparison. Evaluation on the integral constant generator identifies the resulting abelian class map with p1KummerScalarForgetLineMap e.

lean.statement:
theorem p1KummerChernScalar_class_transport
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    {φ : A →+* B} {N : ℕ} {hA : (N : A) = 0} {hB : (N : B) = 0}
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (e : P1KummerScalarEndpoints φ N hA hB T)
    (c : ordinaryFiniteUnit A T ⟶
      (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA T)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) :
    ordinaryFiniteClass B T (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T N B hB) 2
        (e.chernImage c) =
      Sheaf.H.map (p1KummerScalarForgetLineMap e) 2
        (ordinaryFiniteClass A T (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T N A hA) 2 c)
